## Git

### Git and GitHub CLI {#git-github-cli}

git plus gh for pull requests and issues

- **Handleiding:** [Development]({{< relref "/docs/applications/development" >}})
- **Label:** Aanbevolen
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3446-L3448)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install packages from the repositories
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm --noprogressbar git github-cli
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar github-cli
```

- Kept, because other things use them: git

### Kleopatra and GPG commit signing {#git-gpg-signing}

Sign commits and tags with your GPG key

- **Handleiding:** [Development]({{< relref "/docs/applications/development" >}})
- **Label:** Aanbevolen
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3449-L3452) · [`on_git_signing`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L2952-L2959) · [`off_git_signing`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L2962-L2966)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install packages from the repositories
pacman -S --needed --noconfirm --noprogressbar kleopatra

# --- As you ---

# Set git commit.gpgsign to true
git config --global commit.gpgsign true

# Set git tag.gpgsign to true
git config --global tag.gpgsign true

# Set git gpg.program to gpg
git config --global gpg.program gpg
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar kleopatra

# --- As you ---

# Stop signing: unset git commit.gpgsign
git config --global --unset commit.gpgsign

# Stop signing: unset git tag.gpgsign
git config --global --unset tag.gpgsign
```

- Your GPG keys stay where they are. Only git stops signing.

### Topgrade {#topgrade}

Updates pacman, the AUR, Flatpaks and more in one command

- **Handleiding:** [Bijwerken]({{< relref "/docs/cachyos/updates" >}})
- **Label:** `AUR`
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3468-L3470) · [`on_topgrade`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L2989-L2994) · [`off_topgrade`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L2997-L3001)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you, in a terminal window ---

# Install from the AUR: paru shows each PKGBUILD, and you read it before it builds
paru -S --needed topgrade

# --- As you ---

# Write ~/.config/topgrade.toml (skip firmware, use paru)
mkdir -p /home/your-username/.config
[ -e /home/your-username/.config/topgrade.toml ] || cat > /home/your-username/.config/topgrade.toml <<'ZEPHYRUS_EOF'
[misc]
# fwupdmgr wants a reboot into the firmware updater on the G16, rarely what you want mid-update
disable = ["firmware"]
ignore_failures = ["containers"]
assume_yes = true

[linux]
arch_package_manager = "paru"
ZEPHYRUS_EOF
```

Uit de AUR, tenzij een repository die je gebruikt het pakket heeft: dan is het de `pacman`-regel.

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove packages, one at a time (one that something else still needs is kept)
pacman -Rs --noconfirm --noprogressbar topgrade

# --- As you ---

# Remove ~/.config/topgrade.toml if it is still the one this script wrote
if cmp -s - /home/your-username/.config/topgrade.toml <<'ZEPHYRUS_EOF'
[misc]
# fwupdmgr wants a reboot into the firmware updater on the G16, rarely what you want mid-update
disable = ["firmware"]
ignore_failures = ["containers"]
assume_yes = true

[linux]
arch_package_manager = "paru"
ZEPHYRUS_EOF
then rm -f /home/your-username/.config/topgrade.toml; fi
```

### Archi (ArchiMate) {#archi}

Version 5.10.0 from the project, checked against its published SHA-256, in /opt/Archi

- **Handleiding:** [Development]({{< relref "/docs/applications/development" >}})
- **Bron:** [de regel](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3471-L3473) · [`on_archi`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3182-L3201) · [`off_archi`](https://github.com/THectic-NL/Zephyrus-Linux/blob/main/src/static/scripts/quicksetup.py#L3204-L3209)

**Aanzetten**

```bash
# --- As you, first ---

# Download Archi 5.10.0 (about 180 MB) and check it against the published SHA-256
# quicksetup.py does this itself (download_archi), and it amounts to:
curl -fsSL https://github.com/archimatetool/archi.io/releases/download/5.10/Archi-Linux64-5.10.0.tgz -o /home/your-username/.cache/zephyrus-setup/Archi-Linux64-5.10.0.tgz
# ^ the project has renamed its release tags before, so 5.10, 5.10_0, 5.10.0 are tried in that order
echo 'f9422455a00a22f5340dc28692ceafe0ad720c8cde839eaafb0fab1cea57287f  /home/your-username/.cache/zephyrus-setup/Archi-Linux64-5.10.0.tgz' | sha256sum -c -
# ^ nothing is installed unless this matches

# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Install Archi 5.10.0 in /opt/Archi, with a launcher and an 'archi' command
echo 'f9422455a00a22f5340dc28692ceafe0ad720c8cde839eaafb0fab1cea57287f  /home/your-username/.cache/zephyrus-setup/Archi-Linux64-5.10.0.tgz' | sha256sum -c --quiet -
rm -rf /opt/Archi
tar -xzf /home/your-username/.cache/zephyrus-setup/Archi-Linux64-5.10.0.tgz -C /opt
ln -sfn /opt/Archi/Archi /usr/local/bin/archi
icon=$(find /opt/Archi/plugins -name app-128.png | head -1)
printf %s '[Desktop Entry]
Version=1.0
Type=Application
Name=Archi
Comment=ArchiMate Modelling Tool
Exec=/opt/Archi/Archi
Icon=__ICON__
Terminal=false
Categories=Development;IDE;
StartupWMClass=Archi
' | sed "s|__ICON__|$icon|" > /usr/share/applications/archi.desktop

# --- As you ---

# Remove the downloaded archive
rm -f /home/your-username/.cache/zephyrus-setup/Archi-Linux64-5.10.0.tgz
```

**Uitzetten (het terugdraaien)**

```bash
# --- As root, one password prompt for all of it ---

# Remove Archi, its launcher and the 'archi' command
rm -rf /opt/Archi
[ "$(readlink /usr/local/bin/archi)" = /opt/Archi/Archi ] && rm -f /usr/local/bin/archi
rm -f /usr/share/applications/archi.desktop
```

- Archi's models and settings in your home folder stay.
